metadata.name: pokestonksss
metadata.description: PokeStonksss on-chain game: delegated Arena/Trainer accounts on MagicBlock ERs, VRF rolls, oracle mood

instructions.name: arm_timer
docs: ER. (Re)arms the MagicBlock crank sweep for this duel: every 20 s for ~3 minutes the validator's task scheduler
calls `crank_timeout`, which settles the duel if it has been idle for `ABANDON_SECS`. Replaces the previous task.

instructions.name: callback_turn
docs: Called by the VRF oracle (identity enforced by `#[vrf_callback]`). Idempotent: stale/duplicate callbacks are ignored.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: claim_timeout
docs: Anyone may call after the deadline: missing steps default to GUARD; two timeouts in a row forfeit.

instructions.name: commit_pick
docs: Duel: seal a pick as sha256(slot ‖ salt ‖ arena ‖ turn ‖ player).

instructions.name: commit_trainer
docs: Commits the Trainer to the base layer ("Saved to Solana"). Stays delegated.

instructions.name: crank_timeout
docs: ER, crank only (the signer is the task scheduler's PDA). Idle duels are settled: the side that failed to act
forfeits; if neither acted the duel is closed without a result.

accounts.name: crank_signer
docs: Only the validator's task scheduler can sign for this PDA.

instructions.name: delegate_all
docs: Delegates Trainer + Arena to the ER validator passed as `remaining_accounts[0]`.

instructions.name: forfeit
docs: Concede a duel.

instructions.name: join_duel
docs: Guest joins with the secret token from the invite link.

accounts.name: guest_trainer
docs: The guest must be onboarded (its Trainer is updated at settlement).

instructions.name: lock_pick
docs: Practice: lock a move. The House Agent's reply is chosen inside the VRF callback, never from this pick.

instructions.name: mint_badge
docs: Base layer, permissionless: mints badge `id` (an SPL token, supply 1 per owner) to the owner of a Trainer that
has earned it. The check reads the Trainer's last committed state, so progress must be saved to Solana first.

accounts.name: trainer
docs: program); its address proves the data is the real record, and the discriminator is checked on deserialize

instructions.name: onboard
docs: Creates the player's Trainer + Arena PDAs (once per player).

instructions.name: reset_arena
docs: Host may always get a clean arena back (never leaves a player stuck).

instructions.name: reveal_pick
docs: Duel: reveal. The second reveal requests the VRF roll.

instructions.name: save_and_leave
docs: Final commit + undelegate of Trainer and Arena (leave the rollup).

instructions.name: start_practice
docs: Starts an instant practice battle against the House Agent.

errors.name: NotAPlayer
errors.msg: not a player in this arena

errors.name: WrongPhase
errors.msg: arena is not in the right phase for this action

errors.name: BadReveal
errors.msg: reveal does not match the commitment

errors.name: BadgeNotEarned
errors.msg: this trainer has not earned that badge yet (save progress to Solana first)

fields.name: guest
docs: Guest trainer owner (duel) or default (practice vs House Agent).

fields.name: state
docs: duel_rules::MatchState bytes.

fields.name: picks
docs: Pending picks per side (NO_PICK = none). In duels these hold *revealed* picks only.

fields.name: commits
docs: Duel sealing: sha256 commitments per side and which sides committed / revealed (bit0 host, bit1 guest).

fields.name: snap
docs: Oracle snapshot at the bell (price, 0 = unavailable).

types.name: Claim
docs: Marker that a badge was minted to an owner (makes `mint_badge` idempotent per owner and badge).

fields.name: dex
docs: BrokerDex bitmask: bit i set = defeated species i at least once.

fields.name: unsaved
docs: Battles since the last commit to Solana.

fields.name: xp
docs: XP per species (index = species id); level = `duel_rules::level_for_xp`.

fields.name: avatar
docs: Trainer avatar choice 0..=5.
